visual_elements.description: Left confusion-tree: Under 'Positive' (red header) with airplane icon, a red circle '30' branches via dark lines to a red circle '20' labeled TP and a green circle '10' labeled FN. Under 'Negative' (green header) with airplane icon, a green circle '70' branches to a green circle '59' labeled TN and a red circle '11' labeled FP.

Right confusion-tree: Under 'Positive' (red header) with airplane icon, a red circle '30' branches to a red circle '30' labeled TP and a green circle '0' labeled FN. Under 'Negative' (green header) with airplane icon, a green circle '70' branches to a green circle '0' labeled TN and a red circle '70' labeled FP.
Green-bordered box labeled 'Good Model:' containing two bullet lines about proper classifications.
Red/pink-bordered box labeled 'Actually:' containing 'This is Not a Model:' (Not a Model in red) and 'It classifies ALL Samples as Positive'.
Three stacked white calculation boxes on left: Precision, Recall, Average equations with percentages.
Three stacked white calculation boxes on right: Precision, Recall, Average equations with percentages.
Two blue formula boxes: 'Precision = TP / TP + FP' and 'Recall = TP / TP + FN'.
Pink conclusion box with text 'Conclusion: Average is NOT good idea'.
